release.yml:changelog.reason: runs on a pushed tag only; make release-check VERSION=x.y.z is the pre-tag equivalent, not part of the pre-push gate

release.yml:test.reason: workflow_call of tests.yml on the tagged tree; tests.yml:test is the mapped job and make check runs the same suite

release.yml:goreleaser.reason: builds and publishes release artefacts from a pushed tag; needs GITHUB_TOKEN and network, cannot run in a pre-push gate
